newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anscor sees 1997 net at 436 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Anscor sees 1997 net at 436 mln pesos.

text.p: A. Soriano Corp (Anscor) said on Friday it expects its 1997 net income to reach 436 million pesos.
It did not give the latest projection for 1996 earnings.
Anscor recorded 307.358 million pesos net profit in the full 1995 year.
Earnings per share in 1997 were forecast at 0.19 peso, Anscor said in a statement.
Revenues in 1997 was seen at 5.030 billion pesos, and costs and expenses at 4.786 billion pesos.
The company also announced it had set the offer price of its pre-emptive rights offering at 2.50 pesos per share, lower than the 3.00 pesos it had earlier announced last June.
The company is offering three new shares for every five shares held by stockholders on record as of February 14, 1997.
The offering, which will have AB Capital and Investment Corp as the lead domestic underwriter, will start on February 17 and end on February 28.
The proceeds of the offer, estimated at 2.276 billion pesos, will be used to finance the company's service and infrastructure-related investments and repay debt, the company said.
A. Soriano Corp is a holding company engaged in the manufacture of electrical wires and cables, fertilisers and chemicals.
